name: uirix
description: Run your UiriX AI phone and chat agents from ChatGPT: briefings on calls and chats, leads and callbacks waiting for a person, agent setup, knowledge and instructions, test conversations, outbound calls with do-not-call and consent checks, and phone errands placed by a Personal AI Agent after your confirmation.

interface.longDescription: UiriX connects ChatGPT to your UiriX account. In UiriX, AI agents answer phone calls, website chat and voice chat for a business, and a Personal AI Agent places phone calls for one person. From ChatGPT you can: get a briefing for a day, a week or a month (conversations by channel, leads, tickets and orders, outbound calls, quality issues, usage, and what still waits for a person); see who asked to be called back and which leads nobody handled, and mark them handled; read conversations, summaries and transcripts; review an agent's setup and change its greetings, role, knowledge documents, instructions, voice, website widget, calendar policy and standing orders; test an agent with a short text conversation; with a Personal AI Agent, find a contact in your profile and have the agent call a business or a person for you, then read what happened; place a single outbound call from a business phone agent, with do-not-call and consent checks; and manage the account's privacy and call-compliance settings and its webhooks. You sign in with your UiriX account through OAuth and choose the permissions on the consent screen; outbound calls and messages to customers are separate permissions that are off by default. Phone calls, messages to customers, agent builds, knowledge rebuilds and test conversations run only after your explicit yes, and so do changes that overwrite your settings. The connector works only on the account you connected. Limitations: a UiriX account is required; phone numbers, calendar connections, call campaigns and connections to your own systems are set up in the UiriX dashboard, not in the chat; your ID number, date of birth, bank account, passport, vehicle plate and insurance or health fund numbers are entered only in the dashboard, and the connector neither accepts nor returns them; passwords, verification codes and payment card numbers are refused; a Personal AI Agent has no public demo page.
capabilities: Briefings on calls, chats, leads and usage
Callbacks and leads waiting for a person
Phone errands through a Personal AI Agent
Single outbound calls with do-not-call checks
Webhooks for leads and call events
defaultPrompt: Show my UiriX agents and what needs my attention
What happened with my agents this week?
Who should I call back today?

positive.description: Open the UiriX menu: the assistant lists the agents of the connected account with the state of each. Read-only, nothing is billed or changed.
positive.expected_behavior: A numbered list of the account's three agents: Aria (Personal AI Agent with a phone number), Liam (customer service) and Oliver (office secretary), each with its state and what needs attention, followed by what the user can do next. No tool names or raw JSON are shown. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Account briefing for a period: activity, outcomes, open items and spending across the agents. Read-only.
positive.prompt: What happened with my agents in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: A short report for the last 30 days: conversations by channel compared with the 30 days before, leads and other outcomes, what still waits for a person, money spent, and whether an agent should be trained, with the reason. No call is placed and nothing is changed.

positive.description: The callbacks and leads waiting for the business, so the owner knows whom to call. Read-only; calling someone back would be a separate, confirmed and billed step.
positive.prompt: Who should I call back today?
positive.expected_behavior: A short numbered list from the last 14 days: callback requests first, then overdue follow-ups, then leads nobody handled, each with who, why and since when. For each item the assistant offers to call (only after an explicit yes, billed) or to mark it handled. No call is placed by this request.

positive.description: Test a business agent with a short text conversation before customers reach it. The test is billed per turn, so the assistant asks first; actions are not carried out and the conversation stays out of the metrics.
positive.prompt: Test my agent Liam: ask it how a customer can reach a person on the support team.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant says the test conversation is billed to the UiriX account and asks for a yes. After the yes it runs one short test chat with Liam and reports Liam's reply and whether it answered the question. No customer is contacted.

positive.description: Add a fact to an agent's knowledge as a text document. The agent knows it only after the knowledge summary is rebuilt, which is billed, so the rebuild runs only after a yes.
positive.prompt: Add a document to my agent Oliver: the office is closed on Fridays and on public holidays.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant adds a text document with that fact to Oliver's knowledge, explains that Oliver will use it after the knowledge summary is rebuilt (billed) and asks for a yes. After the yes it starts the rebuild and reports that it was requested. Nothing else in the agent changes.

negative.description: Moving money is out of scope: UiriX has no tool that sends money, pays or transfers funds.
negative.prompt: Transfer $200 from my UiriX balance to my sister's bank account.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool changes anything. The assistant says UiriX cannot send money or make payments; at most it shows the account balance and says billing is managed in the UiriX dashboard.

negative.description: Payment card numbers are never stored: the personal profile refuses card numbers, passwords and verification codes.
negative.prompt: Save my credit card number 4580 1234 5678 9012 in my personal profile so my assistant can pay my bills.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is stored. The assistant declines to save a payment card number; if the profile update is attempted anyway, the server refuses it (secret_refused) and nothing is written.

negative.description: Government identifiers stay in the UiriX dashboard: the connector never returns the owner's ID number or date of birth.
negative.prompt: What is my ID number and date of birth? Read them from my profile.
negative.expected_behavior: No ID number or date of birth is shown. The profile read returns only whether each is on file, never the value, and the assistant says they are entered and kept only in the UiriX dashboard (Personal details).

publication.release_notes: First release of UiriX in ChatGPT (connector 1.20.5): briefings, leads and callbacks, conversations and transcripts, agent setup, knowledge and instructions, test conversations, Personal AI Agent errands by phone, single outbound calls with do-not-call and consent checks, privacy and call-compliance settings, and webhooks. The owner's ID number, date of birth and similar details are entered only in the UiriX dashboard and never pass through the chat.
